items.lang|rarcompat|tooltip.rarcompat.mimi_du: When used on a chest, it transforms it into a mimic that drops as many random relics as it originally contained before the transformation.
items.lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.umbrella.d: Softens the fall, providing safe landing from any height. When skillfully used, it can serve as a reliable shield, keeping enemies at bay.
items.lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.umbrella.a: When held in hand, reduces the player's vertical speed, negating fall damage. Pressing LMB propels the player backward and triggers a cooldown of %2$s seconds. The push can be used up to %1$s times in succession before the player touches the ground.
When used, functions as a shield, pushing targets up to %1$s blocks away.
items.lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.umbrella.l: +%1$s experience points for each second of falling.
+%1$s experience points for each mid-air dash performed using the %2$s ability.
+%1$s experience points for each activation of the %2$s ability.
items.lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.plastic_dr: Speeds up the drinking process, not only quickly quenching thirst but also replenishing hunger in an extraordinary way.
Increases drinking speed by %1$s%%. Works on potions and any other items with a drinking animation.
Replenishes %1$s hunger points when consuming liquids. Works on potions and any other items with a drinking animation.
+%1$s experience points for each consumed drink.
items.lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.novelty_dr: Speeds up the drinking process, not only quickly quenching thirst but also replenishing hunger in an extraordinary way.
Increases drinking speed by %1$s%%. Works on potions and any other items with a drinking animation.
Replenishes %1$s hunger points when consuming liquids. Works on potions and any other items with a drinking animation.
+%1$s experience points for each consumed drink.
items.lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.snorkel.de: Allows for longer underwater exploration without the risk of drowning.
items.lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.snorkel.ab: Applies a water breathing effect for %1$s seconds upon full submersion.
Removes the fog effect in liquids.
items.lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.snorkel.le: +%1$s experience points for each second of the water breathing effect from the %2$s ability. If the player already has a water breathing effect, its duration is subtracted from the gained experience proportionally.
items.lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.villager_h: Reduces trading prices with villagers, making deals more profitable.
Increases the discount when trading with villagers by %1$s%%.
Prevents Iron Golems from attacking the player.
+%1$s experience points for each trade with villagers. The amount of experience gained increases by the discount value provided by the %2$s ability.
items.lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.superstiti: Increases loot drops from defeated mobs.

Has a %1$s%% chance to apply an additional level of Looting to defeated mobs. If successful, the ability repeats, adding another Looting level. This continues until the chance fails, summing all levels.
+%1$s experience points for each additional level of Looting activated by the %2$s ability.
